entities.name: Archaeal DNA polymerase II large subunit
observations: The 768-residue query is a PolC/DP2-family large subunit, supported by Pfam domains PolC_DP2_N (positions 8–273), PolC_DP2_central (280–649), and PolC_DP2_cat (666–768).
Sequence homology is exact to reviewed Picrophilus torridus Q6L1K9 and 62–63% identical to reviewed Thermoplasma polymerase-II references over approximately the full query length.
The polymerase is expected to function as part of a heterodimer with a small subunit; exact organism and subunit partner are not established from the supplied sequence alone.

entities.name: DNA polymerization reaction
observations: DNA(n) + 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate → DNA(n+1) + diphosphate; this is the EC 2.7.7.7 DNA-directed DNA polymerase reaction.
The incoming dNTP is incorporated at the primer 3' end using a template, releasing pyrophosphate (diphosphate).

entities.name: 3-prime-to-5-prime exonuclease reaction
observations: The enzyme also has a 3'→5' exonucleolytic activity on single-stranded DNA, cleaving terminal nucleotides to produce nucleoside 5'-phosphates; associated with EC 3.1.11.1 in the reference annotations.
This proofreading/catabolic activity is inferred from highly similar reviewed DP2 homologs and is not directly experimentally demonstrated for the supplied sequence.
